Name: Forbidden Threads
Author: Hankless
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#ff0000][b]⚠️ ALPHA RELEASE ⚠️[/b][/color][/size]
[size=4][b]This mod is currently in early ALPHA. It is being released primarily for testing out mechanics and gathering feedback. Please do not expect a polished, perfectly balanced, or bug-free experience at this stage![/b][/size][/center]
[line]

[center][size=6][b]Forbidden Threads[/b][/size]
[i]Pelican Town is peaceful, idyllic, and full of secrets. It’s time to uncover them.[/i][/center]

[b]Forbidden Threads[/b] introduces a completely new gameplay loop to Stardew Valley: a shadowy underworld of stealth, scavenging, and forbidden alchemy. Sneak into your neighbors' homes, recover their misplaced personal effects, and use arcane machinery to extract the latent magical energy hidden within their clothes to brew impossibly powerful potions.

Will you be a master thief, a brilliant alchemist, or simply a very helpful neighbor who "happened" to find the Mayor's missing attire? The choice is yours.



[line][size=5][b]
🌙 The Art of the Steal: Scavenging & Infiltration[/b][/size]
Villagers are careless, often leaving their personal clothing—from t-shirts and pullovers to highly private [i]signature[/i] items—scattered around the valley and inside their bedrooms.
[list]
[*][b]Listen to the Wind:[/b] Start your day with a whisper on the wind, giving you a gut feeling about where someone might have dropped something.
[*][b]Craft Lockpicks:[/b] Clint’s anvil isn't just for hoes and axes anymore. Craft Copper, Iron, Gold, and Iridium lockpicks to bypass locked doors and access private rooms. Better lockpicks mean higher success rates and fewer broken tools.
[*][b]Stay in the Shadows:[/b] Sneaking into rooms isn't without risk. NPCs have line-of-sight and are protective of their belongings. If you’re caught trespassing or rummaging, you will be forcibly thrown out, lose friendship, have your stolen items confiscated, and suffer the [b]Suspicion[/b] debuff—putting the whole town on high alert and severely reducing future item spawns for days.
[*][b]Distractions & Lures:[/b] Need to get Robin out of her lab? Craft Smoke Bombs and Noisy Decoys to draw villagers away from their precious belongings while you slip in.
[*][b]Search the Beds:[/b] Empty beds can be quickly searched or thoroughly tossed for loot. But what happens if you try to search a bed while someone is sleeping in it? [i]You'll have to be bold enough to find out.[/i]
[/list]

[size=5][b]⚗️ Arcane Alchemy: Extraction & Brewing[/b][/size]
Once you have secured your ill-gotten garments, the real magic begins.
[list][*][b]The Essence Extractor:[/b] Build this whirring, mysterious machine to break down clothing into pure, liquid magic. A miner’s jeans might yield [i]Mining Essence[/i], while an athlete's jacket might yield [i]Speed[/i] or [i]Attack Essence[/i].
[*][b]Signature Mojo:[/b] If you're lucky enough to extract a villager's highly personal [i]Signature[/i] clothing, you might discover their [b]Mojo[/b]. Mojos are incredibly rare, powerful modifiers unique to each NPC that completely alter how a potion behaves (e.g. Abigail's Mojo gives a chance to skip potion cooldowns, while the Wizard's Mojo can massively extend duration).
[*][b]The Essence Brewer:[/b] Place an empty crafted Flask (from Crude Vials to Master Flasks) into the Brewer, fill its slots with your extracted essences, and optionally add a Mojo.
[*][b]Dynamic Potions:[/b] The Brewer dynamically generates your potion based on your exact recipe. Mix Speed and Combat to create a "Quicksilver Warbrand Tonic," or go all-in on Luck for a "Fated Serendipity Draught." Beware: mixing more than two conflicting essences triggers a Complexity Penalty, diluting the duration and potency of your brew!
[/list]
[size=5][b]🎭 Social Engineering: Unique Gifting[/b][/size]
Not into alchemy? You can play the hero instead.
[list]
[*][b]Lost & Found:[/b] Return a villager's clothing directly to them for a massive friendship boost (+50 points) and highly unique, tailored dialogue. Returning items bypasses the weekly gift limit! (Warning: If you try to return an NPC's most private garments when you have less than 4 hearts of friendship... expect them to be horrified and call you a creep).
[*][b]Taste the Magic:[/b] Gift a villager a potion brewed using their own personal [i]Mojo[/i]. They will recognize their own magical resonance, resulting in specialized reactions and an automatic "Loved" gift response.
[/list]

[size=5][b]🗝️ Master the Craft: The Interaction Skill[/b][/size]
Integrated seamlessly via the [b]SpaceCore[/b] framework, Forbidden Threads adds a brand new [b]Interaction[/b] skill to your player profile. Level up by successfully picking locks, finding clothing, searching rooms, and brewing potions.

At levels 5 and 10, choose your path:
[list]
[*][b]The Infiltrator Path (Ghost / Kleptomaniac):[/b] Master the shadows. Learn to run without waking sleeping targets, slip away from being caught without losing friendship, and score double loot when rummaging through rooms.
[*][b]The Alchemist Path (Master Brewer / Transmuter):[/b] Master the cauldron. Speed up your extraction times, yield double the essence, force your flasks to hold impossible amounts of magic, and occasionally find rare transmuted items left behind in the machinery.
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]📦 Getting Started[/b][/size]
Once the mod is installed, keep an eye on your crafting menu. You'll automatically unlock your first [b]Copper Lockpick[/b] and [b]Crude Vial[/b] at Level 1 Interaction. As you level up the skill, you'll unlock the blueprints for the Essence Extractor, the Essence Brewer, better lockpicks, better flasks, and specialized lures.

[*]Requires [b]SpaceCore[/b].
[*]Fully compatible with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b]! Spawn locations and stealth spots automatically adjust based on whether SVE is installed.
[/list]

[line]

[size=3][b]🤖 Transparency Note on AI Usage[/b][/size]
Please note that this mod—including its code, dialogue, and assets—was developed with significant assistance from AI tools. Using AI helped bring this highly complex and ambitious project to life. I know that AI in modding is a sensitive topic and that some players prefer to strictly support entirely human-made content. I want to be completely upfront and honest about its use here so you can make an informed decision before downloading and playing.

Downloads.Description: First public alpha release. Major systems are in, but the mod is still unfinished. Placeholder assets, tuning gaps, missing polish, and bugs are expected.
